id: 9a0c8e21-7b2d-4f31-9c4a-3b8e0f7a1d22
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a Google Cloud Storage bucket whose name matches the pre-v1.148.0 Vertex AI Python SDK's predictable default staging-bucket pattern '<projectId>-vertex-staging-<region>'. Pre-positioned squatted buckets enable the Unit 42 'Pickle in the Middle' cross-tenant RCE attack.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/google-vertex-ai-sdk-flaw-let-attackers.html
    - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/hijacking-vertex-ai-model/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
    - attack.resource_development
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1583.006
logsource:
    product: gcp
    service: gcp.audit
detection:
    selection:
        protoPayload.methodName: 'storage.buckets.create'
    bucket_pattern:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[a-z]+[a-z0-9-]*$'
    filter_uuid_post_patch:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}'
